RCE-VC: Law of Version Control

Let humans and AI swarms commit in parallel: check changes against 100,000 name-free items in 70 microseconds while staying on Git.

[70 µs & 317 µJ Admission @ 100,000 Items]

1/3 Many people and AI agents can submit code at once, and a named check admits changes or records why not.

2/3 Tracking code by name-free functions instead of text lines lets unrelated edits land together without pointless merge wars.

3/3 Developers keep using ordinary Git while admission against one hundred thousand items finishes in about seventy microseconds.
